title: Classification of (non)-frustrated 2D Ising models in genus 1 on isoradial graphs
summary: We prove a complete classification of 2D Ising models defined on isoradial graphs, frustrated or not, whose underlying spectral curve has genus 1. As a specific case, we recover Baxter's Z-invariant Ising model, thus extending his class of models to real coupling constants. We identify two additional families of models, both having non-Harnack spectral curves. We show that in all cases the spectral curve is maximal.
